replication.target_description: Experiment 3 direct replication: group (congruent/incongruent) × novelty (familiar/novel) interaction in 2 × 2 × 2 mixed ANOVA of familiarity ratings, with difficulty as the other within-subjects factor; first-stage analytic sample.

n.sample_role: Participants in the stage 1 analytic sample; 68 congruent and 76 incongruent.
n.exclusions: 175 completers; 2 excluded for not clearly seeing all pairs, 2 for major distractions, 18 for failing method check; first 144 of 153 remaining cases by completion time/date analyzed.
n.quote: The first (as determined by completion time and date) 144 of these comprised the analytic sample (n = 68 in the congruent group and n = 76 in the incongruent group).

reported_success.quote: We therefore conclude that the SCORE H* claim has been replicated

notes: Input study/outcome locators are empty. The supplied replication report explicitly identifies Experiment 3 group × novelty interaction as the selected claim, anchoring test selection on both sides. Original F and p are a secondary transcription: the replication report explicitly reproduces original Section 4.2 in a labeled left-hand column. They were not independently checked against a locally acquired original full text. Original analytic n is not explicitly printed in this excerpt and was not inferred from degrees of freedom. The replication report is a July 2020 final stage-1 report, despite the November 2025 reference date. Replication requested Cohen’s f² is printed explicitly; the alternate partial eta-squared is .03. The original paper title and DOI were verified through PubMed/PMC metadata. Primary original acquisition failed: DOI landing page inaccessible, PMC browser challenge (one web cache returned opening article content but subsequent access returned challenge), Europe PMC fullTextXML HTTP 500, CiteSeer PDF HTTP 404. No original challenge page was retained as paper text.
